items.title: eBay (EBAY) Faces A New Seller Threat As Meta Launches Marketplace App
items.summary: Meta has launched a dedicated Seller app for Facebook Marketplace, aimed at professional sellers. The app focuses on enhanced seller tools and potentially lower fees, directly challenging eBay's core seller base. This development introduces fresh competitive pressure on eBay's marketplace model and its high-margin seller segment. eBay, traded as NasdaqGS:EBAY, now faces a new competitor targeting the same professional sellers that are central to its marketplace model. items.title: Meta (META) Launches Lightspeed Tie Up To Track In Store Sales From Ads
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) and Lightspeed Commerce have launched a direct integration that syncs in-store sales data with Meta's advertising systems. The integration allows physical retailers to connect point-of-sale transactions to Meta ad campaigns, even without an ecommerce site. The move is aimed at improving attribution of Meta ads to offline purchases and expanding Meta's role in brick-and-mortar retail marketing. items.title: Meta Stock Is Down Nearly 10% in 2026. Should You Buy Before July 29 Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Meta's stock has shed nearly 10% while its business keeps accelerating, creating a tension that puts investors in a tough spot ahead of the July 29 earnings report. Whether the pullback is an opportunity or a warning depends on one question Wall Street is still debating.
